Easy to use and versatile as a mask or quick swipe. Plus actually seems to work?!
My skins stays bright and clear. Everyone always asked what I'm using for my brightness. It's these pads!!!!

I noticed the difference in my skin after one use! I think I found my new holy Grail product. You can stretch the pads into a custom fit as well, but pregnant women be careful as this does contain retinol.
It works well. But, i cant use it often because the smell makes me sick.

definitely worth the price and i have actually repurchased the refill for this as well!! i never had a product give me a noticeable change like this before. my skin has gotten brighter and faded my acne scars, i use this both am and pm, even will leave it on my skin as a face mask while i do my hair. wish ulta would carry more from this brand.

I've had the same dark spots for years that I just couldn't seem to get rid of. I tried this product with the combination of another one plus religiously applying sunscreen and my skin truly hasn't been more even. I say improvements within days.

I really want to like this product but the breakouts its causing is frustrating. I tried slowly integrating them into my routine but didnt matter, I continued to breakout. The Mediheal blue for acne is very nice and helped with my problem.

I like it, didn't tingle, burn or break me out which is the most important thing to me. I haven't noticed any crazy brightening changes on my skin yet but it's super hydrating and it feels nice on the skin. One con is that the pads are super thin and one isn't enough to wipe across the face.

avis.titre: The pad is incredibly soft and...
avis.texte: The pad is incredibly soft and there is absolutely no irritation. The formula is just right, ending with a smooth finish, which is why I think this product deserves the top spot. You can definitely feel the moisture inside once you use it. This is a product that you must try at least once. There are no downsides apart from the price... Since the overall price range of cosmetics is too high, it seems that people don't buy them often unless they're on sale.

The Vitamide Blemish Pads are a must­try for anyone dealing with dull skin tone, dark spots, or blemishes! With vitamin C derivatives and niacinamide, consistent use really helps brighten your complexion. The dual­sided pads are super convenient ­ one side for exfoliating dead skin cells, the other for soothing and absorption. They're packed with essence, leaving your skin hydrated, and they're gentle enough for daily use, even on super sensitive skin! The slight downside is that the brightening effects aren't immediately noticeable, so you need to be patient and use them consistently. If you have more stubborn dark spots, you might need to combine these with other brightening products for better results. While the pads are generously sized, they're a bit small for covering the entire face, making them more suitable for targeted brightening. The subtle citrus scent might be a bit much for those with sensitive noses. Also, the pads are quite saturated, which can lead to some dripping! I like to use these pads instead of toner after cleansing, and I even leave them on my cheeks and cheekbones for about 3 minutes as a mini mask. They're especially great in the morning ­ they make your makeup look so fresh! When I'm concerned about dead skin cells, I gently wipe with the textured side, but usually, I just press the smooth side to help absorption. Pro tip: keep them in the fridge for an extra cooling effect ­ they're a summer essential!

I've been consistently trying all the different versions, and it's true that the tea tree one is the most versatile. Compared to the blue one, both have softer pads, and the vitamin version wasn't bad either. It just feels average, nothing more, nothing less. I can't really sense any distinguishing features compared to other products.

I've tried this vitamin product once, and while it's too early to tell, I can say it has a strong vitamin scent and feels moisturizing. In the morning, I noticed my complexion seemed a bit brighter! As described in the product details, you can stretch it along your skin's texture, making it easy to apply where needed. However, I'm not sure about its effectiveness in improving blemishes. Still, it's decent overall.

avis.titre: I've been using this for about...
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a year now. Even though I'm not big on skincare products, I could actually see the results. The best part is how convenient it is, and the pads are quite large, so you don't need to use many. That's why even when I'm in a rush, I can quickly swipe one or two pads and be out the door! They don't adhere well, and there's a lingering sticky feeling on your hands at the end. They're also not easy to pull out, and the tweezers? They fall off quite often. Sigh... They just won't stay put. Make sure to buy when there's a 100+100 deal. As for the tweezers, you need to press them down until you hear a 'click' for them to stay in place! If they don't work after pressing, you might need to try repositioning them.

First off, there's a generous amount of ampoule, which I really appreciated. I felt like it gave my complexion a more radiant appearance. The distinctive scent was a bit too intense for my liking. Other than that, I didn't notice anything particularly unusual.

Thin sheet mask Instant brightening effect Recommended when whitening is the main goal The sheet is a regular cotton pad, not a gauze (mesh) type, so it's less effective at reducing heat compared to other pads

The product comes with tongs, which makes it convenient to use. I often use this before bed and in the morning before makeup. It really helps my makeup go on smoothly. I used to use carrot pads, but they weren't as hydrating as I expected. Since switching to these, I've noticed that with consistent use, my complexion has brightened by about half a shade. They're also great for combating deep dryness. The pads are quite thin, so they dry out too quickly, which is a bit disappointing. For the best brightening results, you need to leave the pads on for as long as possible! In the morning, I apply them for about 5 minutes before doing my makeup, and it really helps the makeup adhere well. In the evening, I leave them on until they're completely dry. You can actually see the areas where the pads were applied becoming visibly brighter!

avis.titre: The square pads are great for...
avis.texte: The square pads are great for masking larger areas, and the essence feels wonderfully smooth. The container was a bit inconvenient for carrying around, but I appreciate that refills are available.

1. The pads are incredibly thin and adhere well to the skin, making them perfect for masking. 2. The subtle fragrance makes it pleasant to leave on for extended periods. 1. Possibly due to their thinness, they tend to dry out quite quickly. 2. Can leave the skin feeling dry.

I live using skin pads like these. Have previously tried the Lazy Day pads by Peach and Lily, and love those but a but pricey. Ive tried other rands as well and liked them all. But these are the best i have ever used! They are a bit different than other brands in that they are thinner - but its more serum based and ive found more effective! After you wipe, leave them sitting on your skin while getting ready. They are like mini sheet masks. It makes my skin soft, reduces fine lines, and brightens. I will definitley repurucase!
I will have to come back to this. I use this in the morning but it doesn't make my skin brighter like I thought. I only used it for 2 weeks

I bought this because it contains liposomal vitamin C for better absorption. It's moisturizing and has a pleasant, subtle citrus scent. While it may not reduce blemishes, it definitely brightens the complexion. Just remember, vitamin C products should be applied in the evening. If you use it in the morning, be sure to apply sunscreen thoroughly. Also, since vitamin C can be drying, don't forget to follow up with a good moisturizer. I purchased this hoping it would reduce blemishes, but it only brightened my complexion. After it absorbed, my skin felt slightly dry. These pads are great for masking. Apply to your face, leave on for 5 minutes, then remove. Gently wipe your entire face before applying your essence, emulsion, and cream for best results.

avis.titre: You can take care of toning...
avis.texte: You can take care of toning, masking, vitamin C, and hydration all in one step The container... While refills are nice, it feels like it doesn't close tightly. You'll understand once you try it, sigh It's great to apply on vitamin C care days while drying your hair. However, I wouldn't recommend using it with an exfoliating toner!

I started using these Monday, before I went into work on night shift. By last night, Wednesday, only three days/uses later, I receieved SO MANY compliment on how radiant my skin was. They speak for themselves, honestly.

avis.titre: I applied 3 patches each on my...
avis.texte: I applied 3 patches each on my cheeks and forehead after cleansing. Then I peeled them off gently, followed by applying emulsion and cream. While I can't say for certain if my skin became brighter or if my pigmentation faded, these patches were convenient to use on mornings when I didn't feel like doing a full mask routine. During the period of use, I didn't experience any downsides like blemishes or a burning sensation on my skin. For an extra boost of hydration, try placing a thin layer of plastic wrap over the patches after applying them!
My skin has noticeably smoothened out and I am having little to no acne and my skin is very clear
Smells so good and very gentle with the skin will keep getting it

I have only used this product for a few weeks now. I have noticed it leaves my face softer without drying or irritation. I appreciate system and easy it is to take the cloths from its compact container.

avis.titre: I received this as a sample...
avis.texte: I received this as a sample and it seems great for deep dryness, so I rushed to get more! I haven't noticed any downsides yet. I'll need to use it more to know for sure.

avis.titre: True to its Vitamide name, it...
avis.texte: True to its Vitamide name, it has a refreshing scent and a soft texture, making it gentle and non­irritating when used as an exfoliating toner. Since my face tends to get quite warm, I usually leave it on for about 5 minutes like a mask. When I remove it, the heat has subsided, which is fantastic! It's also very hydrating, providing excellent moisture to the skin. I'm not sure about its brightening effects. There aren't really any downsides...? I'm still using it happily, so I plan to repurchase when I run out. For those buying from Olive Young, make sure to get it during the buy­one­get­one­free promotion! I bought it during this deal last year, and even though I've been using it on and off (due to laziness), I'm still using it now. Also, because of its soft texture, I think it works better as a mask you leave on rather than as an exfoliating toner.

I've been using this product for over a month, and it's been a real game­changer! It's wonderfully hydrating and has a delightful bouncy texture. Plus, it's been fantastic for clearing up my blemishes ­ talk about killing two birds with one stone! The packaging is absolutely gorgeous too. As someone with oily skin, I'm thrilled to say it suits me perfectly. As for brightening... I can't say I've noticed any significant improvements. I'm not really convinced about its effectiveness in that department.

avis.titre: After using it for about a...
avis.texte: After using it for about a week, my skin texture has improved and feels moisturized. Above all, the pads are incredibly soft ­ I can't stress this enough! I highly recommend it. I bought it for its whitening claims, and while I'm not sure about actual lightening, my skin definitely looks more translucent and clearer. It was supposed to help with blemish removal, but I'm not really seeing much difference in that area, unfortunately. If you use this after Hwahae and top it off with the Mediheal serum, it's absolutely perfect for hydration.

The pads are incredibly gentle, causing no irritation at all. They're packed with hydration, making them perfect as both a mask and toner. Even with my super sensitive skin, I experienced no irritation whatsoever. I wish the moisturizing effect lasted a bit longer. Also, I'm not quite sure about its brightening effectiveness ­ that's a bit disappointing. I use it like a mask, just leaving it on my face.

Honestly, this is the best Mediheal toner pad I've ever tried! The fabric is so stretchy that I could adjust it perfectly to fit my face. Even when I applied it before makeup, my skin absorbed it beautifully! I bought this because it claimed to brighten the skin, but I couldn't really notice any brightening effect...

avis.titre: My face looks clearer and the...
avis.texte: My face looks clearer and the hydration doesn't evaporate, keeping my skin constantly moisturized. I also love how thin the essence inside is, and there's a generous amount of what seems to be essence or toner in the package. The vita pads don't have any effect on blemishes, but they work wonders for brightening the skin. It feels great when you store them in the refrigerator for a cool, refreshing effect.

avis.titre: I found it easy to use and...
avis.texte: I found it easy to use and noticed a brightening effect on my face There wasn't really anything to complain about... though I wouldn't mind if it came in a larger size!

First off, as someone with super sensitive skin, I experienced absolutely no irritation. Unlike the tea tree pads from the same company that have a gauze­like texture causing slight irritation when wiping, these have a soft material that adheres instantly, which I loved. After a few weeks of use, I noticed my blemishes had faded a bit and my complexion seemed brighter somehow? It was great for calming my skin and providing hydration too. If I had to mention something inconvenient, it would be the tongs. They're a bit awkward to use and keep dropping the pads.

avis.titre: My skin is so sensitive that...

There's nothing I dislike about it. Sometimes two sheets come out at once, but that's hardly a complaint!

I tried this product for my AM skincare routine and the results are amazing. I have normal sensitive skin and this does not irritate it at all. Within a week of consistent use my skin was brighter and more even. After a few weeks I literally have a bit of a glass skin effect without any products when I wake up in the morning. Your mileage may vary with this product but for me it gave the best immediate and lasting results of any treatment product I've personally tried.

I consistently applied this only to my cheeks, and wow, just my cheeks got brighter! So I've been covering the rest of my face to match the tone of my cheeks. If you're going to use it, I think it's better to go for the larger mask version. There's nothing particularly bad to mention. It adheres well and doesn't cause blemishes.
I wamted to like these so bad. I have sensitive dry skin. Started using thesw daily and I broke out with white heads all over my face.
I bought this to helo with brightening of the skin and the eye and I've seen results in four weeks of usage. I love this stuff, it's brightening and makes your skin look healthy and alive.

avis.titre: O M G... One of the best things I've tried!

It has really been a game changer, as I've been searching for moisturizing products to help my dark spots & dryness subside. I am unsure of my skin type, but it gets dry extremely with no kind of moisturizer but would also get overly oily throughout the day to the point where it would itch and I would get cystic pimples, this product has not given me any irritation or itchiness at all! I will definitely be keeping this in my routine.

avis.titre: I apply these to my cheeks for...

Personally, I haven't experienced any disappointments or inconveniences with this product!

avis.titre: This is my go­to staple! It's...
avis.texte: This is my go­to staple! It's so gentle and amazing!! I've finally settled on these pads as my holy grail! The pads are a bit too thin, which makes them roll up slightly when wiping. That's a bit disappointing.

The generous amount allows for liberal use. Being skin pads, they don't necessarily brighten the skin, but after applying and removing, my skin felt hydrated and clearer. Applying these before makeup makes the skin plump and helps the makeup adhere beautifully. Great product!

The pad size is larger than expected (perfect for placing one on each cheek) 3. Moisturizing ­ effective for hydration 4. Gentle ingredients and a mild scent I don't have any negatives! I've been using this product for several bottles now. It's gentle and great. After cleansing, I place them on my cheeks while I do other things, then move on to the next step in my skincare routine.

It's moisturizing and has a pleasant scent. The ampoule doesn't dry out quickly, so you can use it until the very end while maintaining hydration. I'm not sure about its effectiveness in improving blemishes. I wouldn't recommend it for those with super sensitive skin. If you use it simply as a hydrating mask without expecting too much from its other functions, it might be a good choice.

Love these pads. Gentle soothing And bring out the glow from within. This is a fabulous company. On a daily basis, all I do is use the pads (whichever one I feel my skin needs that day) Followed by a tinted SPF and two coats of mascara And my natural beauty from within shines!!

While it might be different since they're in the same product, it still makes me feel a bit uneasy.

I've used many toner pads before and this is the first from Mediheal and best one so far. The pad isn't too thick (that will fall onto the ground as they lack stickiness) or too thin that would rip easily. Im using before serum twice a day. My skin feels tight and less dull after 2 weeks using.

I use this only at night and i think it did brighten my skin and make everything look less dull and just improve my overall skin texture

If you don't stretch and apply it carefully, it might not adhere properly. Some might find it a bit tedious to separate each sheet. I'm still contemplating whether to repurchase.

This is one of my favourite products to use every morning, it brightens and tightens the face and the best part is my makeup applies perfectly every time after I use this. Can not live without this product
Love love love Korean skincare my skin has never been so amazing besides obagi. Love. Clean and clear.

I bought these per Tik Tok recommendations. The pads are really soft and stay on your cheeks and forehead while you are getting ready. I use these in place of toner sometimes. I use it with retinol and vit c serums.

avis.titre: When I want to do my daily...
avis.texte: When I want to do my daily mask routine but don't want the hassle of essence dripping everywhere, this is perfect. It's so convenient to just pat it on and relax. Applying it for just 5 minutes before makeup helps my foundation go on smoothly. It's simple and effective! I wish I could use it during the day when I'm at home, but I feel like I should apply sunscreen afterwards. So I end up only using it at night, which is a tiny bit disappointing. However, I have no complaints about the product itself.

I previously bought the Collagen pads and I loved them so much I added these to my regimen. You can use the pads as a mask they hold in and provide so much moisture and product. I love the compact packaging and tweezers that help you only pull off one pad at a time. Really great value.

I purchased these three months ago after discovering them on TikTok to help lighten the acne scars on my skin. I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's brightness just after using them twice. Now, I incorporate them into my nighttime skincare routine as a mask to enhance my skin's radiance.

avis.titre: I think this is a hidden gem...
avis.texte: I think this is a hidden gem among Mediheal toner pads, relatively less famous but truly wonderful! My skin is super sensitive, but this caused no irritation, which I loved. The pads stretch well, so you can easily fit them to your cheeks or forehead. Also, I really appreciated how thin and soft the pads are. There's honestly nothing bad to say... If I think of any drawbacks, I'll be sure to add them! I've gone through more than three tubs of these toner pads. I highly recommend them to those with sensitive skin like mine who want to try pads with vitamin ingredients.

It's nicely moisturizing. The gauze pads are great because you can tear them into smaller pieces. I like to tear them and apply just to my nose and chin areas. Why do vitamin­infused pads always sting a bit when they get in your eyes? Ouch! Also, I'm not really sure if they're effective at reducing blemishes.

This product visibly brightened my complexion more than any other I've tried. I'm thrilled I got such great results at such an affordable price! The lid is a bit tricky to open and close. Even the tweezers struggle to grip the mask properly. Word of caution: avoid using this when your skin is acting up. I learned that the hard way, unfortunately.

I loved it so far! I have all the other box to. I am stilll trying them to check if they helps my skin on the long term. For now really satisfied. Please don't change your formula. I hope one day we will have one of those boxes specifically rosaceas. I have sensitive skin and I used all of the other pad toners and have no issue with any of them.

As someone with sensitive, blemish­prone skin, I've been using this as a doctor's office treatment and experienced no irritation. I loved the immediate brightening effect. My skin feels smoother, and the hydration is excellent! Even with my extremely oily skin, I didn't notice any stickiness. It's well­rounded and great for daily use. It has a distinct lemon scent, which I personally dislike as I'm not fond of sour fragrances. Other than that, no complaints! While it works well as a face pack, the pads are thicker than they appear in the photos. When used as a face pack, it kept falling off my face. It seems more suitable as a doctor's office treatment.

The essence wasn't excessive, striking a perfect balance without dripping. After applying the pad for about 15 minutes, I could instantly see how plump and firm my skin became. The treated areas noticeably contrasted with the untreated parts, showing a more even complexion and cleaner look. It also helped reduce skin warmth. I'm eager to continue using this product consistently. While it seems effective for refining skin texture, I didn't notice significant improvement in reducing blemishes. The pad is quite large for just the forehead area. It might be better to cut it in half and use it on the chin or nose separately for more targeted application.

avis.titre: I love how refreshing it feels...
avis.texte: I love how refreshing it feels every time I use it, and I haven't noticed any downsides after application. I don't have any complaints, but I've only been using it for a month, so I'll need to use it longer to fully assess it.

avis.titre: An Impulse purchase you won't regret!
avis.texte: If you want a face that is bright and tight look no further! This product is amazing and I can't wait to try the others as a first­time shopper of this brand best believe I will be a repeat purchaser. Usage 1­2 times per week. Leave on for 5­10mins and rub the pad/ pads around areas the pads didn't cover for full coverage! feels relaxing and refreshing on my face (Note that I have sensitive skin)

I started using this product at the end of July. I can totally tell the difference. When used at night I wake up still with a slight glow. When used in the morning the glow last throughout the day. I'm so glad u found this and will purchase again
I loved these. I noticed my skin definitely cleared up after a couple of uses. Loved the packaging and how it came with tongs to grab the pads

I've been using tea tree products, but this is my first time trying Vitamide. I feel like my complexion is getting a bit brighter, so I plan to keep using it. I love how convenient it is to use one sheet at a time. It would be great if you could have more frequent sales or promotions on the price. It's good to use right after cleansing, but I also like applying it as the final step after other products. When I leave it on for a bit, it seems to help the serums I used before absorb well into my skin.

avis.titre: I love how the pads stretch to...
avis.texte: I love how the pads stretch to cover my entire cheeks and forehead! With consistent use, I've noticed a slight improvement in brightening, so I've been diligently using them at night! Since these aren't hydrating pads, it's disappointing that they dry out quickly after just a few minutes of application.
ive gotten the moisturizing ones from this brand and loved them but these re tough to say. They make me glowy but as far as evening and brightning my skin tone they dont really do much.
The toner pad is hydrating and looks good on my skin. I noticed improvement on my skin tone and blemishes. I finish the whole thing so I will def order again!

After using it, I definitely feel like my skin looks brighter! I'll probably buy it again! I haven't found any downsides yet! If I had to pick something, maybe the scent? But I actually like the fragrance, so it's fine with me.

avis.titre: At first, there was quite a...
avis.texte: At first, there was quite a bit of liquid left, so I used it generously each time. The quantity was substantial, but by the time I got to the end, the liquid had dried up. I did use it intermittently though. With consistent use, I noticed a slight brightening effect on my complexion, but no dramatic changes. I mainly used it for hydration, applying it nightly and removing it after some time. The included tweezers were great for hygiene, but they weren't very effective at gripping. I'd usually end up using three sheets at a time. The lack of significant results was a downside. Also, even with the lid closed, it dried out after about a month or two. Though that could be because I opened the lid frequently. Since the mask is stretchable, you can extend it over your face and then use the remainder on your body.

I bought this a month ago once Ulta got it in store. I heard great things about all the pads from this brand and knew I had to try one. I went with this one since I have stubborn acne scars, and I have noticed a visable difference since using! My scars aren't completely gone yet but most are far lighter than ever! I use like 3 pads as a mask at night and just 1 as normal during the morning and I still have plenty left. Will definitely be repurchasing!
It feels moisturizing and the vitamin ingredients seem to brighten my complexion! With prolonged use, it can feel a bit drying! It's best to apply and remove it in moderation.

I used this while blow­drying my hair, and it stayed on without falling off. After use, my skin texture was noticeably refined and cleaner. The package contains a generous amount, so I always used two at a time. There's plenty of solution inside, keeping it moist until the very end. The pad itself doesn't have many textured bumps, so it might not be sufficient for exfoliating dead skin cells.
They smell amazing and they also feel amazing on the skin, I leave the pads on my cheeks for 5 mins to absorb the essence.

There's a generous amount of toner, enough to use with cotton pads even after finishing the included ones. It leaves the skin feeling deeply hydrated. The pads are a bit too thin, making them somewhat inconvenient to use for cleansing. It doesn't seem to effectively reduce blemishes.

avis.titre: Moisturizing with a thin sheet that stays put even when you
avis.texte: ­ Moisturizing with a thin sheet that stays put even when you move your face ­ The pads are large enough to cover both cheeks, forehead, and chin separately. I use four pads, then after 10 minutes, I put one on my neck before discarding ­ Nothing particularly bad, but the brightening effect isn't notably visible ­ If you're looking for an exfoliating pad to remove dead skin cells, this isn't it

I love trying different facial pads, and recently I've been dealing with more intense deep dryness, which led me to purchase the Mediheal pads. They're great because I can stick them on my cheeks while blow­drying my hair, and they stay put without falling off, keeping my skin nicely hydrated. While they were moisturizing, I didn't notice any significant improvement in terms of blemishes. It seems they're mainly good for hydration.
It's great that it's not irritating and doesn't leave a sticky feeling after use There are price differences across platforms, so it might be best to compare before purchasing

I love these toner pads. I been using them with beauty of Joseon glow serum and both of those combined helped a lot with my dark spots and less breakouts. Also I been breaking out since the beginning of spring and tried everything of Korean skincare to get rid of these breakouts and dark spots and finally after using those two combined help a lot. I would definitely recommend getting them.

I got these to use as an occasional boost for my skin. I really like how they feel against my skin. The case they come in is very nice, it's a clean design that looks good on display. They come with little plastic tweezers to use when pulling out the pads to avoid contamination by touch. For folks who struggle with sheet masks, I highly recommend these. I'm not a huge fan of sheet masks because they impede my vision and breathing in a way that is too much for me sensorily. These are a perfect alternative for me. I can lay them over my t­zone easily and they stay in place while I move around the house.
Extremely hydrating and worth the price. Large quantity. Last a while since a whole pad can cover the surface of your face. I've ordered this twice now.

Love these toner pads! I have used Numbuzin No. 5 toner pads in the past but they feel sticky until after a few minutes. Mediheal pads are non­sticky, have light fragrance, and they really help with my blemish. Results show in a few weeks but overall happy with the product.

avis.titre: The case is sturdy and cute.
avis.texte: The case is sturdy and cute. The pads come in a generous quantity, lasting me about 3 months. The pads are thin, so I used them without any irritation to my skin. Sometimes vitamin products can make my skin tingle, but this one didn't at all. The essence is also nicely hydrating. Apart from the hydration, I'm disappointed that there aren't any special effects. The pads are thin, which makes them a bit tricky to take out.

The thin pad adheres perfectly to the skin, is rich in ampoule, and is great for easy skincare maintenance The pads are on the smaller side, so they get used up quickly, which is a bit disappointing in terms of value for money

I use these as masks! i take 2 pads and place them on either side of my face for 10 mins like a face mask, sometimes I move one pad to my forehead after a while. It's soothing and hydrating without being sticky or overly fragranced. Great for sensitive skin

I wasn't looking for these but so glad I found them. Watching YouTube videos of Korean influencers, I see this is a favorite in K­Beauty. I love vitamin C products to help brighten my complexion. When I began using them I used them three times a week just to make sure there would be no reactions and there weren't. I rotate my skincare so I don't use them every morning and night, but I can. The enclosed tweezer is very handy. I plan on purchasing the refill and may also try another type from the line.

I really felt like my complexion was brightening up. I kept it in the fridge, and it was so refreshingly cool to use! The downside is that, to be honest, the effects aren't very noticeable. While my skin tone seems lighter, I'm not sure about any improvement in blemishes. Try storing it in the fridge ­ it feels absolutely refreshing when applied!

This toner pad is amazing, it has helped and has hugely reduced the appearance of my bags. One thing tho, I recommend using these toner pads for your morning routine with the retinol and collagen pads followed with a moisturiser and then sunscreen. You can actually use two to three toner pads for your day time OR night time routine, but some of the products are best not to mix. Try do your research on what toner pads or even just what kind of skin care is best to pair, and skin products that are best not to use together.
